universePolicy: current frozen survivor universe; no historic-constituent performance claims; quote-currency nominal accounts; metals excluded from initial requested scope

sample.unit: symbol x eligible completed daily decision x direction
sample.eligibility: 250 valid continuous completed daily bars; complete feature availability; both long and short; independent of Elliott confirmation

wave.pivots: strict completed-daily extrema radius 2 and 5; occurrence and confirmation tracked separately; equal/dual extrema skipped
wave.availability: only use pivots after right-window bar completion; record asOf, confirmation and input cutoffs; no full-series ZigZag labels

formulas.leg_size: direction*(pivot[j].price-pivot[j-1].price)/decision_ATR14, last six legs from last seven available alternating small pivots
formulas.leg_duration: pivot occurrence index difference in continuous completed daily bars, strictly positive
formulas.ratios: consecutive absolute leg sizes and durations; zero denominator -> null with missing flag
formulas.structure_flags: compare last two available confirmed highs and last two confirmed lows; insufficient history -> null

indicators.atr14: simple mean of last 14 true ranges using prior daily closes; atr14/close
indicators.rsi14: Wilder RSI; recursive smoothing from fixed segment start; denominator zero -> 100 or 50 for flat
indicators.rvol20: current volume / mean of 20 strictly previous daily volumes; missing stays null with flag
indicators.returns: direction-oriented log close returns over 5,20,60 bars
indicators.volatility: population standard deviation of last 20 daily log returns
indicators.weekly: last complete week close vs SMA20 of completed weekly closes, normalized by daily ATR; no current-week partial bars

context.direction: one long and one short row per eligible daily decision; paired rows remain in same fold
context.market: us/ca/crypto categorical; no symbol ID or outcome-derived sector ranks
context.currency: metadata for accounting only, excluded from predictors
context.availability: daily >= close/completion; weekly >= conservative final daily completion of calendar-confirmed last session; add five-minute research observation delay

sample.missingPolicy: optional volume and insufficient pivot history -> null plus missing flags; required price/calendar/ATR gaps -> ineligible; reset state at path gaps; imputation learned on train only

executionLabel.entry: first regular-session stock research-4H or complete UTC crypto-4H open at or after decisionCompletedAt+5min, within deadline; OHLC completion used only to establish retrospective verified path
executionLabel.stocks: regular 09:30–16:00 Eastern; same four-hour plus three-hour-source conservative session segments as reviewed Trend; early close/missing segment requires authoritative session data or unresolved outcome
executionLabel.crypto: four complete aligned UTC hourly sources per 4H; omit live/nonaligned provider rows
executionLabel.unresolved: missing path, split inside feature/holding window, nonpositive stop, provider revision or boundary ambiguity not covered by stop-first -> unresolved, never stop/zero/success; exclude from supervised fitting but retain coverage records
executionLabel.collision: opening adverse stop gap fills open; opening favorable target gap fills target; else intrabar both stop-first
executionLabel.knownVsFuture: entryOpen, target, stop, holding path and exit are label-only future data; decision features never read them
executionLabel.policyDifference: new ATR-based ML opportunity policy, not Elliott V1 fixed C stop/extension; compare as a distinct challenger, never substitute its labels for Elliott account returns
executionLabel.short: hypothetical price P/L with notional reserved; no sale-proceeds leverage; excludes borrow/funding/dividends/FX

split.holdoutSymbolPolicy: all rows excluded from train, tuning and calibration; primary final score only these symbols in final time block; warmup raw data may compute features but must not train model
split.priorEvidence: the 20-symbol Elliott structural audit is observed development evidence; no claims its period or symbols are untouched; final labels for reserved 12 must not be inspected during tasks 1–4
split.purge: for every train/validation boundary require label information end < next block start; both directions and all rows same UTC decision session assigned together across symbols
split.embargo: exclude fitting decisions within 75 calendar days before each validation/test boundary, in addition to exact interval purging; use same exclusions across all symbols
split.walkForward: 2 chronological validation windows: 2026-01-01 to 2026-03-01 and 2026-03-01 to 2026-04-01; expanding past train with exact interval purge and 75-day embargo; no random splits
split.rightCensoring: only labels resolved by observation cutoff allowed; unfinished/unavailable paths not labeled flat or loss
split.thresholdSelection: model, preprocessing, calibration, trade threshold and ranking locked using train/validation before opening primary final test
split.finalLabelMaturity: all final decisions end by 2026-07-24, at least 75 days before 2026-10-07 source cutoff; keep every unresolved path in coverage and never select by early outcome resolution
split.insufficientBlockSupport: insufficient label-horizon-sized independent blocks -> inconclusive confidence evidence; no challenger promotion regardless of nominal row count

baselines: constant training class frequencies and training mean net R
modelPlan.candidate: one preregistered tree model in task4 after checking installed dependencies; at most 8 total model-setting trials; no per-symbol tuning
metrics: portfolio realized and marked drawdown using causal risk admission
modelPlan.acceptance: integrity gates mandatory; probabilistic model must beat training-frequency baseline on pooled forward validation log loss; report paired block-bootstrap uncertainty; primary heldout net R lower 95% block CI >0 after costs and no sign reversal under 0.10R stress cost; otherwise inconclusive/reject; no auto promotion
modelPlan.retraining: future scheduled candidate training only after approved deployment task; immutable model/data/split versions and challenger evaluation; no live self-modifying rules

task2Gate.engineering: GO for frozen data acquisition, feature builder and synthetic causality tests
task2Gate.productionTraining: BLOCKED pending full-universe source continuity/corporate-action/calendar audit, enough resolved labels per market/direction, split feasibility and sealed final partition
task2Gate.sampleMinimumBeforeTraining: at least 12 months train decision coverage, 500 resolved train samples per market/direction, 100 resolved per validation market/direction; raw counts are dependent, not effective independent sample size
